The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, spanning roughly 400 px, so about 15 px per cm. The food is scrambled eggs covering roughly 200 x 180 px, which is about 13 x 12 cm. Allowing for irregular edges, the real footprint is closer to 100 cm². The pile is probably 2 cm thick, so the volume is about 150-200 cm³. Scrambled egg is fairly dense but fluffy, so I'll assume about 0.7 g/cm³. That gives roughly 110-140 g. Scrambled eggs run about 150-200 kcal per 100 g, and these look cooked with butter, so I'll use about 170 kcal per 100 g. At 130 g that comes to about 220 kcal.
